# Provenance Headers (SC-006 / FR-011) + tracked-not-ignored proof (FR-013)

Every generated/derived artifact carries machine-readable provenance, and every
replaced drift-check now emits an actionable "regenerate" diagnostic on failure (FR-012).

## Per-artifact provenance

1. **Skill tree** (`.claude/skills/**`): byte-identity wins for each SKILL.md (FR-003), so
   provenance is carried by a single **tree-level manifest** at the derived root (research R5):

   `.claude/skills/GENERATED.md`:
   ```
   # GENERATED — do not edit.
   #
   # This skill tree (.claude/skills/**) is generated by enumeration from the
   # canonical Codex source tree .agents/skills/** by FS.Skia.UI.Build.SkillTreeGen
   # (feature 044). Every SKILL.md here is byte-identical to its canonical
   # counterpart; edit the canonical file under .agents/skills/ instead.
   #
   # Canonical source: .agents/skills/
   # Regenerate via: ./fake.sh build -t RefreshSurfaceBaselines
   ```

2. **Constitution fragments**: provenance is in the BEGIN/END marker comments themselves,
   each preceded by a generated-from hint. Example from `.specify/templates/plan-template.md`:
   ```
   50:<!-- Generated from .specify/memory/constitution.md by `./fake.sh build -t RefreshSurfaceBaselines`; do not hand-edit between the markers. -->
   51:<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: constitution/fsi-visibility -->
   53:<!-- END GENERATED: constitution/fsi-visibility -->
   ```

3. **validation.contract.yml**: carries its `# GENERATED from … Routing.fs` header:
   ```
   schema_version: 1
   
   # GENERATED from build/Governance/Routing.fs (feature 042). Do not hand-edit;
   ```

4. **Skillist annotation** (inline token, cannot carry a header): provenance is the documented
   canonical-source rule (deps is canonical) surfaced by the active-feature currency diagnostic
   (`SkillistView.staleDiagnostic` names the regeneration command).

## Actionable regenerate diagnostics (FR-012)
Every currency failure names `./fake.sh build -t RefreshSurfaceBaselines` rather than a bare
"A and B differ": `SkillTreeGen.currencyDrift`, `SkillistView.staleDiagnostic`,
`ConstitutionFragments.currencyDrift`, and `ContractView.currencyDrift` all do.

## Tracked, not gitignored (FR-013)
$ git check-ignore .claude/skills/GENERATED.md .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md .specify/templates/*-template.md validation.contract.yml
```
(none ignored — PASS: all generated/derived artifacts are committed)
```
